snippet.title: Opus: Prism Peak - Official Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Opus: Prism Peak is a narrative-driven adventure game where you play a weary photographer who finds himself caught outside of reality. Using your old camera, you’ll explore an ethereal realm and its ties to the world you left behind, uncover its mysteries, and ultimately find your way home. Check out the new Opus: Prism Peak trailer. Opus: Prism Peak will be available on PC in Fall 2025.
